conventions.boundary_binding: Exact boundary_id for candidates; case_id plus matching model SHA256 for deployment rows without boundary_id. Positions always come from the graph catalogue.
conventions.graph_scope: All graph boundaries, including workflow-ineligible positions; bars do not imply compiler or runner support.
conventions.bytes_unit: MB = cut_bytes / 1000000, matching the graph-analysis GUI.
conventions.generic_line: Thin line through admitted measured points is only a visual guide; no unmeasured FPS are estimated.
conventions.native_points: Measured points only; no connection or interpolation.
conventions.quality: Candidate analysis_eligible; deployment numeric relative loss against CPU-ONNX, at most 5%.
